mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the dermis and epidermis was most worthwhile: the result explained how epidermal cells receive nutrients from vessels below while the surface limits water loss and senses touch.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the finished skin to the body felt mostly like an expected finishing step, with little new explanation beyond the earlier layered skin.

surprise.text: The nutrient arrows from vessels below the epidermis clarified how its living cells are supplied even though the vessels stop beneath it.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; the combinations had clear purposes, though after the first choice each offered combination was the only one available.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it introduced a new relationship to explore. The skin construction was clear, but the mostly single-option sequence left little room for decisions.
